AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Weed control? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Weed control.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Weed control.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Weed control.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Weed control.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agricultural Land? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agricultural Land.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Agricultural Land.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agricultural Land.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agricultural Land.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Land Preparation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Land Preparation.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Land Preparation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Land Preparation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Land Preparation.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying General Crop Harvesting? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about General Crop Harvesting.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on General Crop Harvesting.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to General Crop Harvesting.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for General Crop Harvesting.

6. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

7. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of soil? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of soil.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of soil.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of soil.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of soil.

9. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

10. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Selected Crop? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Selected Crop.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Selected Crop.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Selected Crop.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Selected Crop.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain General Animal Health and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Beekeeping and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Rearing Project 3.0 Agricultural Technologies and Entrepreneurship 3.1 To and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Rearing Project and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Ice melting to water

2. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Weed control.

3. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agricultural Land.

4. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Land Preparation.

5. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for General Crop Harvesting.

6. B — newton (N)

7. C — Producers

8. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of soil.

9. D — 100 °C

10. D — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

11. A — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

12. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Selected Crop.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of General Animal Health; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Beekeeping; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Animal Rearing Project 3.0 Agricultural Technologies and Entrepreneurship 3.1 To; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Animal Rearing Project; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
